name: Adobe client secret uuid
description: The uuid the I/O Management API returns for each client secret of an OAuth Server-to-Server credential. It identifies a secret rather than being the secret: the list response returns only the uuid and metadata (no client_secret values), and the delete request takes the uuid in the URL because the plain-text client secret cannot be used to identify which secret to delete. The pages show it as a 32-character lowercase hexadecimal value; no sample is recorded.

sources.supports: No client_secret values are returned by the list API, only the secret uuid and other metadata; the secret uuid is needed to delete a secret and the plain text client_secret cannot be used to identify which secret to delete.
sources.locator: sections "List all client secrets" and "Remove client secret from credential"
